meta.title: Contact — Request a consultation
meta.description: Tell us about your company and what you need help with. Forcelis will respond with a straight answer about whether and how we can help.

hero.title: Request a consultation.
hero.subtitle: Tell us about the business and what you are trying to understand. If Forcelis is not the right fit, we will say so.

form.name: Name
form.help: What would you like help with?
form.messageHint: The more specific the question, the more useful the first conversation.
form.consent: I have read the Privacy Policy and consent to Forcelis processing this information in order to respond.
form.successBody: Thank you. We will get back to you at the email address you provided.
form.errorTitle: The message could not be sent.
form.errorBody: Something went wrong on the way. Please try again, or write to us directly.
form.unconfiguredTitle: The form is not connected yet.
form.unconfiguredBody: This site has no form endpoint configured, so nothing would be delivered. Set PUBLIC_FORM_ENDPOINT before publishing — see the README.
form.validationConsent: Please accept the Privacy Policy to continue.

steps.title: We read it properly
steps.body: A person reads the message, not a routing rule. If the answer is that we are not the right fit, that is the answer you get.

steps.title: A short conversation
steps.body: Thirty minutes to understand the business and the question. No preparation needed on your side.

steps.title: A concrete proposal
steps.body: Scope, approach and what is needed from you — based on what we discussed, not on a standard package.

assurance.title: Two things worth knowing before you write
items: Forcelis never asks for tax portal or banking credentials. Analysis works from files you export yourself.
Information shared in a first conversation is treated as confidential, whether or not an engagement follows.
